artifactContract.module: lib/contract-model/verified-units.ts (Phase-3 side; imports IR + verification types and, for the adapter, the boundary's types - all type-only; no runtime code)
artifactContract.perUnit: PersistedVerifiedUnit { ruleOrDefinitionId; kind: RULE|DEFINITION; verifiedIdentity: RuntimeVerificationIdentity; unit: complete IRRule|IRDefinition; verification: complete SemanticVerificationResult (verbatim); artifactHash }
artifactContract.perCandidate: PersistedVerifiedUnitPackage { schema p3-verified-unit-package.v1; companyId; instrumentKey; candidateRef; runId; compilerVersion; verifierAlgorithmVersion; verificationStatus; units[]; unpaired[{id, kind, reason}]; problems[]; counts; complete; packageHash }
artifactContract.perRun: VerifiedUnitRunManifest { schema p3-verified-unit-manifest.v1; companyId; instrumentKey; runId; compilerVersion; verifierAlgorithmVersion; candidates[{candidateRef, packageFile, packageHash, complete, artifactHashes, counts, problems}]; totals (+ problemsByCode, completePackages, incompletePackages); verificationStatusCounts; complete }
artifactContract.shapeReuse: PersistedVerifiedUnit is the boundary's VerifiedUnitArtifact plus `unit` and `artifactHash`; toVerifiedUnitArtifact is the identity function on the shared fields; toVerifiedExecutionPackage builds the boundary package from the persisted units' own IR (the exact units verified), never from whatever IR is loaded.
artifactContract.noBooleanShortcut: no verified / isVerified / passedVerification field exists in the module or in any persisted record (source-shape test + serialized-bytes test).
artifactContract.identityTiming: snapshotUnitsForVerification(compiled) is taken BEFORE the verifier runs: deep-frozen clones plus identity read from each unit at that moment. buildVerifiedUnitPackage persists from the snapshot; if `currentUnits` (the live IR now) disagree with the snapshot identity, the unit is refused as IDENTITY_MISMATCH rather than persisted under a stale claim. persistCandidate throws if a verifying runner does not pass the pre-verification snapshot.
artifactContract.whatIsNotDoneHere: no path -> exprId resolution, no MATERIAL filtering, no execution decision, no clock read, no compiler or verifier semantic change. sourceContentVersion is persisted as the compiler emits it (null today, so identities are WEAK) - populating it is a compiler concern, not touched.

completeness.rule: complete = no problems AND no unpaired unit AND every snapshotted unit persisted AND at least one unit

problems.IR_WITHOUT_VERIFICATION: compiled but not verified (the compile-only run) - every unit listed as unpaired, complete false
problems.VERIFICATION_WITHOUT_IR: the result names a unit the candidate did not compile - the 411/498 pattern - named by id, complete false; bindable units are still persisted
problems.DUPLICATE_UNIT_ID: a unit id twice - both refused, nothing chosen
problems.IDENTITY_MISMATCH: identity drifted between verification and persistence - refused
problems.MIXED_COMPANY / MIXED_INSTRUMENT: a unit for another company/instrument - refused and named

completeness.manifest: complete only when every candidate package is complete and there is at least one; totals and problemsByCode expose every gap; an empty run is not complete

determinismAndImmutability.serialization: canonicalJson: sorted object keys, array order preserved (a finding list's order is part of the exact result); no timestamps inside the artifact - runId is caller-supplied
determinismAndImmutability.artifactHash: sha256 over canonical (id, kind, verifiedIdentity, unit, verification); changes when unit content, identity or result changes (pinned)
determinismAndImmutability.packageHash: sha256 over the canonical package body; re-checked on parse along with every artifact hash, so an edited file is refused rather than trusted (pinned)
determinismAndImmutability.byteIdentity: same units (in any order) + same result + same identity -> identical bytes and hashes (pinned)
determinismAndImmutability.snapshot: JSON-clone then deep-freeze; mutating the live IR or the live verification result after build changes nothing in the stored package; the stored package is frozen (pinned)

harnessIntegration.evidenceWriter: scripts/p3-conmed-pilot/evidence.ts: persistCandidate({dir, name, runId, compilerInput, result, verification, run, snapshot?}) writes verified-units/<name>.verified-units.json (serialized, secret-scanned, written FIRST) then the evidence file with a `verifiedUnits` pointer {file, packageHash, complete, artifactsPersisted, unitsMissingVerification, problems}; VerifiedUnitManifestWriter accumulates packages and writes verified-units-manifest.json (secret-scanned). A secret hit anywhere aborts both writes.
harnessIntegration.runPopulation: run-population.ts now calls persistCandidate (compile-only: verification null, package records every unit unverified, complete false) and writes the manifest every 20 candidates and at the end. The bare writeCandidateEvidence call is gone.
harnessIntegration.numericGroundingValidation: numeric-grounding-validation.ts snapshots BEFORE verifyCompiledCandidate, then persistCandidate with the snapshot, and writes the manifest. Pinned: the snapshot call precedes the verify call in source.
harnessIntegration.forensicEvidencePreserved: buildCandidateEvidence is unchanged in content: rawModelOutput, toolCallLog, full IR, context bundle, verifier result (incl. numericAssertions groundings, admissibleEvidence), run metadata; schema still p3-candidate-evidence.v1 with one additive optional field.
harnessIntegration.noPostProcessing: the pair is produced from the same in-memory objects in one call; no script reconstructs it later.

roundTripsThroughTheStrictBoundary.path: buildVerifiedUnitPackage -> serializeVerifiedUnitPackage -> parseVerifiedUnitPackage -> toVerifiedExecutionPackage -> evaluateVerifiedCapacity / simulateVerifiedTransaction. No hand-built envelope, no patched identity, no inserted fields.

roundTripsThroughTheStrictBoundary.BLOCKED_TRANSACTION: through the round-tripped package: REVIEW_REQUIRED, committable false
